objective: Reemitir el frente P5 Runtime URL Profile sobre el SHA actual, ahora que el Universal Worker esta ONLINE, sin cola, con generation y worker_code_tree alineados. Crear el perfil canonico no-secreto de development y permitir que el workflow use vars.TEST_BASE_URL como override o el perfil canonico como fallback. No tocar backend funcional, RBAC, SQL, Worker core ni Produccion.

actions.old:
- name: Validate secure profile reference
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
actions.new:
- name: Resolve canonical runtime URL
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${TEST_BASE_URL:-}" ]; then
            RESOLVED_BASE_URL="$(python - <<'PY'
import json, os
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(os.environ['P5_RUNTIME_PROFILE_FILE'])
data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert data.get('environment') == 'development'
assert data.get('secret') is False
value = str(data.get('base_url') or '').strip().rstrip('/')
assert value.startswith('https://')
print(value)
PY
)"
            test -n "$RESOLVED_BASE_URL"
            echo "TEST_BASE_URL=$RESOLVED_BASE_URL" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi

      - name: Validate secure profile reference
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

constraints: No secret values in repository or worker queue
GitHub Environment development remains source for TEST_SUPERADMIN_EMAIL and TEST_SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD
Do not modify Universal Worker core
Do not send email or WhatsApp
